node.statement: The registered compressed-product-display and epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms give universal K_m and e_m>0 with ||A dot B||<=K_m||A||||B|| for every compatible amplified rectangular pair: bound A dot B by AB plus the universal O(e) compression error, use ||AB||<=(1+epsilon)||A||||B||, and restrict to e<=min(e_m,1). Combining this with the two coarse column comparisons from the preceding child gives q_P(A dot U)<=K_q^2*K_m||A||q_T(U). Enlarge K to dominate K_q,K_m,K_q^2*K_m.
